Animations start one level lower, because the top level tilted and scaled the whole page on every page change.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The green flash and the trembling page were the same bug** ([#228](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/228)). "Wild" tilts the page 1.2 degrees and scales it to 96% on every page change, while the cards inside slide in on transforms of their own. Nested like that, each gets its own compositing layer: on Firefox/macOS the coloured badges painted out of uninitialised layer memory, which is the `#38FF38` green, and Chromium showed the same doubling as trembling instead.
- **Animations now start at "Subtle"**: 6px, no tilt, no scale. Nobody had chosen the top level, it was simply what shipped. **Wild** is unchanged and still available under Settings, General, Animations.
- **A strong-level choice made before the setting was renamed carries over** instead of being reset to the new default.

## 🔍 Not verified here

- The green flash was traced in the code and from the reporter's recordings. There is no macOS machine with Firefox on this side, so that the flash stops is a conclusion, not an observation.
